I tap on Makoto's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Makoto 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : {i}Hello?...{/i}
: Makoto? Why are you talking so quietly?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你怎么说话这么小声？

lines.en: : {i}Because I'm in the library...I can't talk right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我在图书馆……现在不能说话。{/i}

lines.en: : Where are you? You're going to need to speak up.
lines.zh: : 你在哪儿？你得说大声点。

lines.en: : {i}I said I'm in the-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我说了我在——{/i}

lines.en: : Makoto? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你还在吗？

lines.en: : I'm in the damn library, Sen- Ah!
lines.zh: : 我在他妈的图书馆，Sen——啊！

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, I know. I'm so sorry. It won't happen again.
lines.zh: : 是。是，我知道。非常抱歉。不会再这样了。

lines.en: : The[school] library? I'll meet you there.
lines.zh: : [学校]的图书馆？我过去找你。

lines.en: : {i}Oh, no. The public library near the maid cafe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，不是。是女仆咖啡厅附近的那个公共图书馆。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don't bother coming, though. I have to stu-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过你别过来了。我还要复——{/i}

lines.en: : Cool. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 好。待会儿见。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and begin to make my way over to the library...
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，动身往图书馆去……

lines.en: scene black
scene makotogennoon
When I arrive, I find Makoto nose-deep in some book about religion.
lines.zh: 到了之后，我看见 Makoto 埋在一本讲宗教的书里。

lines.en: Well, when I say {i}nose-deep{/i} I really just mean she's very invested.
lines.zh: 我说「埋在书里」，其实只是说她特别投入。

lines.en: If you were to actually attempt to bury your nose inside of a book, it would likely cause you a lot of pain.
lines.zh: 要是你真把鼻子往书里塞，大概会疼得够呛。

lines.en: At the same time, however, the topic she's found herself taking on today would probably cause even more pain if she were to truly get wrapped up in it.
lines.zh: 但同时，她今天挑的这个题目，要是她真的一头扎进去，大概会让她更疼。

lines.en: Of all the things to waste your time studying, why choose the one thing no one will ever agree on?
lines.zh: 值得花时间学的东西那么多，为什么偏挑一个永远没人能达成共识的？

lines.en: There are no gods. There isn't anything other than what's in front of us right now.
lines.zh: 没有神。除了此刻眼前的东西，什么都不存在。

lines.en: I tell Makoto this and ask her to put down the book.
lines.zh: 我把这话说给 Makoto 听，让她把书放下。

lines.en: She calls me an idiot.
lines.zh: 她骂我白痴。

lines.en: The cycle continues.
lines.zh: 这个循环又继续了下去。

lines.en: scene black with dissolve
I hang out for a little while longer, watching a strange smile creep across her face as new information finds its way into her brain.
lines.zh: 我又多待了一会儿，看着新的信息钻进她脑子里时，她脸上慢慢浮起一种奇怪的笑。

lines.en: It pushes aside other pointless things she has studied-
lines.zh: 那些东西把她学过的其它没用的玩意儿挤到一边——

lines.en: And contaminates her with the single most deadly poison known to man.
lines.zh: 并用人类已知最致命的毒把她污染了。
